S2-03_skyhook.after_capture: glider hangs on 1.5 m line as a tiny kite (L/D ~6 -> line elevation ~80 deg) and a 3 s reel pulls it into the dorsal quiver
S2-03_skyhook.verdict: CONDITIONAL add-on: relative KE 0.03-0.3 J and ~0.98 single-pass capture on paper, but the approach volume is 2-3 m behind the head; needs proof that turbulent wake behind a skier (0.5-1 m) does not upset the glider.

S2-04_crosswind_kite.elevation_centre_deg: can be held ~35-50 (crosswind window) vs ~74 parked
S2-04_crosswind_kite.stops: still lands at standstill (no wind) -> needs glide-down to a backpack line-cradle; same as round-1
S2-04_crosswind_kite.verdict: CONDITIONAL, hand to kite2 team: active figure-8 extends airborne fraction and lowers the view, at the cost of a periodic +-30 deg orbit in the footage and an autopilot on the kite.
